description.en: Sketch types, signatures, and module structure before code, then stay in the loop while implementation fills in. Use for /architect, 'architect this', 'design this', or non-trivial work where jumping to code would lock in the wrong shape.
description.zh: 写代码之前，先画出类型、函数签名和模块结构的草图，然后在填充实现的过程中一直跟着。用于 /architect、「architect this」、「design this」，或者一上来就写代码会把错误的结构定死的、不简单的活。

blocks.en: Before writing code, trace every system the change touches, then sketch two different shapes for it (types, signatures, module boundaries) and pick the one where each piece of state has one owner, each task has one way to do it, and callers need to know least. Redesign instead of patching if workarounds repeat.
blocks.zh: 写代码之前，先把这次改动碰到的每个系统都摸清楚，然后为它画两种不同的结构（类型、函数签名、模块边界），挑出这样一种：每份状态只有一个主人，每件事只有一种做法，调用方需要知道的最少。如果绕路的写法反复出现，就重新设计，不要打补丁。

blocks.en: For a large or contested design, run the **arena** skill instead of sketching alone.
blocks.zh: 设计很大或有争议时，运行 **arena** 技能，不要一个人画草图。

lessons.quote: Before writing code, trace every system the change touches, then sketch two different shapes for it (types, signatures, module boundaries) and pick the one where each piece of state has one owner, each task has one way to do it, and callers need to know least.
lessons.quoteZh: 写代码之前，先把这次改动碰到的每个系统都摸清楚，然后为它画两种不同的结构（类型、函数签名、模块边界），挑出这样一种：每份状态只有一个主人，每件事只有一种做法，调用方需要知道的最少。

zh.title: 硬要第二个方案，再按标准挑
zh.does: 它至少画出两种结构不同的设计，再按三条具体标准挑一个，不会抓住第一个想法就开写。
zh.why: 只要一个方案，AI 就会交第一个想到的；要两个，再给出「一个主人、一种做法、知道得最少」这三把尺子，比较才有依据。
zh.try: 要方案时写：「给我两个思路完全不同的方案，按成本、好不好改、别人好不好接手三条比一比，再选一个。」

en.title: Require a second design, then judge
en.does: It sketches at least two differently shaped designs and picks by three concrete tests, instead of running with its first idea.
en.why: Ask for one design and you get the first idea; ask for two plus the tests (one owner, one way, least to know) and the choice has grounds.
en.try: When you ask for a plan: "Give me two very different approaches, compare them on cost, ease of change and handoff, then pick one."

lessons.quote: Redesign instead of patching if workarounds repeat.
lessons.quoteZh: 如果绕路的写法反复出现，就重新设计，不要打补丁。

zh.title: 写明什么时候推倒重来
zh.does: 同一种绕路一再出现时，它回头重新设计，而不是在错误的结构上越补越多。
zh.why: 「什么时候放弃」很难判断；把「绕路反复出现」定成信号，AI 就不会放弃得太早，也不会补个没完。
zh.try: 定改流程的门槛：「同一类投诉反复出现，就重新设计流程，别再单独补救。」

en.title: Say when to start over
en.does: When the same workaround keeps coming back, it redesigns instead of piling patches onto the wrong shape.
en.why: "When to give up" is hard to judge; making repeated workarounds the signal keeps it from quitting too early or patching forever.
en.try: Set a bar for a process: "If the same complaint keeps coming back, redesign the process instead of patching each case."

lessons.quote: For a large or contested design, run the **arena** skill instead of sketching alone.
lessons.quoteZh: 设计很大或有争议时，运行 **arena** 技能，不要一个人画草图。

zh.title: 按事情大小加人手
zh.does: 小设计它自己画；大的或有争议的设计，它让几个模型各画一份再挑。
zh.why: 写明在什么条件下升级做法，AI 就不会小事兴师动众，也不会大事一个人拍板。
zh.try: 给 AI 一个升级条件：「小改动你直接定；牵涉三个以上页面的，先拿两三个方案给我比。」

en.title: Scale the effort to the stakes
en.does: It sketches small designs itself, and for large or contested ones has several models each sketch one to pick from.
en.why: Naming when to escalate keeps the AI from overdoing small jobs or deciding big ones alone.
en.try: Give an escalation rule: "Decide small changes yourself; for anything touching three or more pages, show me two or three options first."

lessons.quote: Use for /architect, 'architect this', 'design this', or non-trivial work where jumping to code would lock in the wrong shape.
lessons.quoteZh: 用于 /architect、「architect this」、「design this」，或者一上来就写代码会把错误的结构定死的、不简单的活。

zh.title: 说出跳过它会出什么事
zh.does: 碰到一上来就写代码会定死错误结构的活，它先停下来设计，不会直接开写。
zh.why: 光说「复杂的活用它」很模糊；点出跳过的后果（结构被定死），AI 才判断得出哪些活值得先设计。
zh.try: 交代规矩时连后果一起说：「发群公告前先给我看，发出去就撤不回了。」

en.title: Name the cost of skipping it
en.does: On work where jumping to code would lock in the wrong shape, it designs first instead of starting to code.
en.why: "Use it for hard work" is vague; naming the cost of skipping it (a locked-in shape) lets the AI tell which jobs need design first.
en.try: State the rule with its cost: "Show me group announcements before sending; once they're out, they can't be taken back."

en.intro: Before code, it traces the systems involved, sketches two shapes, and picks by one owner per state, one way per task, and least for callers to know. Repeated workarounds mean a redesign, and large or contested designs go to `arena`.
